title: Dastoor juda jaana
body:
Dastoor juda jaana
<<MINI>>
Hai Ishk E Mohammad (S.a.w.w.) Ka Dastoor Juda Jaana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeene Ki Alamat Hai Sarkar Pe Mar Jaana
<<MINI>>
Hai Ishk E Mohammad (S.a.w.w.) Ka Dastoor Juda Jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
Tai Kar Ke Yeh Nikla Hai Ghar Se Koi Deewana.....2
Is Baar Madine Se Wapas Hi Nahi Aana
Jibril Se Bhi Aage Pohuche Hai Shab E Asrar.....2
Kaam Aagaya Zarron Ka Kadmon Se Lipat Jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaa Poch Le Adam (A.s.) Se Mitti Hai Kharab Uski.....2
Jis Ne Bhi Mohammad (S.a.w.w.) Ko Apna Sa Bashar Jana
Salman Ka Shaida Hun Behlol Ka Aashik Hun.....2
Kehti Hai Mujhe Dunia Deewano Ka Deewana
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Roz Hi Hoti Hai Aaqa Ki Sana Akbar.....2
Har Roz Hi Hota Hai Jannat Me Mera Jaana
<<MINI>>
Hai Ish E Mohammad (A.a.w.w.) Dastoor Juda Jaana.....
author: Mir Hassan Mir
